evaluation.interpretation: The available producer/channel failed to execute the predeclared image-edit contract. This is evidence against using this producer path as the R-IMG-1 Class C mechanism; it is not evidence that all grounded generative image editing is inherently incapable of adding value.

stopConditionTriggered.reason: No valid edited photograph was produced after three bounded attempts; continuing would amount to tuning around a producer-contract failure rather than evaluating the predeclared Class C hypothesis.

provenanceNotes: Invalid generated reports must not be used as benchmark metrics or fidelity evidence.
Any metrics/verdicts embedded inside invalid generated outputs are producer-generated text, not measured research results.
The factual H45 source and reviewed deterministic A/B candidate remain the only valid visual authorities for this case in the current experiment.
nextDecision: Do not expand Class C to other benchmark cases. First decide whether a producer with an explicit source-image edit contract and inspectable output semantics is available; otherwise conclude R-IMG-1 with deterministic A/B as the currently supported path.
